sources.title: AROhI: An Interactive Tool for Estimating ROI of Data Analytics
sources.snippet: II Related Work In recent years, the assessment of the ROI for ML solutions across various domains has increased. This section explores existing research, tools, and frameworks, focusing on ROI estimation in data analytics, particularly for ML and AI applications.
